lead.you: Built from your sub-periods and the slow planets moving into new signs.
lead.other: Built from their sub-periods and the slow planets moving into new signs.

note: Sub-period dates come from the Moon at birth and can shift by a few weeks if the birth time is off.

transitLine.Jupiter: {{planet}} moves into {{sign}}: a wider, more generous season begins.
transitLine.Saturn: {{planet}} moves into {{sign}}: a slow, steady reshaping starts.
transitLine.Rahu: {{planet}} moves into {{sign}}: restless energy finds new ground.

lastStretch: Last stretch of {{planet}}. Wrap things up before {{next}} begins in {{date}}.

Sun.0: Keep stepping forward. Be clear with people in charge.
Sun.1: A good month to be seen and to take the lead.
Sun.2: Credit comes, along with some friction at the top. Stay steady.

Moon.0: Home and family set the pace. Make room for them.
Moon.1: Feelings run closer to the surface. Look after the people near you.
Moon.2: A good month for home matters and quiet time.

Mars.0: Keep acting on plans, and keep your temper in check.
Mars.1: Energy is high. Put it into one clear goal.
Mars.2: Move fast on what matters, slow on arguments.

Rahu.0: Try new directions, but test them before committing.
Rahu.1: Restless energy. Chase the new, keep your feet on the ground.
Rahu.2: Changes tempt you. Not all of them will last.

Jupiter.0: Say yes to good advice and the doors it opens.
Jupiter.1: A good month to learn something or find a mentor.
Jupiter.2: Support is around you. Ask for it.

Saturn.0: Steady effort. Slow progress still counts.
Saturn.1: Keep building. What you put in now holds later.
Saturn.2: Patience pays this month. Do the dull work well.

Mercury.0: Learn, write, deal and connect. Small moves add up.
Mercury.1: A good month for study, paperwork and pitches.
Mercury.2: New connections come easily. Follow up on them.

Ketu.0: Finish what is open. Let go of what no longer fits.
Ketu.1: A quieter month. Finish more than you start.

Venus.0: Enjoy what you have. Relationships and money do well.
Venus.1: Love and comfort come forward. Make time for both.
Venus.2: A good month for money matters and for beauty in daily life.
